name: Claim-Code Voucher
description: Lock satoshis to the hash of a secret code. Whoever knows the code can claim the funds, so value can be handed over as a code instead of an address.

issuer.name: Issuer
issuer.description: The party who funds the voucher and chooses the claim code.

claimer.name: Claimer
claimer.description: The party who knows the claim code and collects the funds.

createVoucher.name: Create voucher
createVoucher.description: Lock satoshis so that whoever knows the claim code can collect them.

issuer.name: Create voucher
issuer.description: Provide the amount and the hash of the claim code.

claimVoucher.name: Claim voucher
claimVoucher.description: Reveal the claim code to collect the funds locked in a voucher.

createVoucherTransaction.name: Voucher created
createVoucherTransaction.description: $(<voucherSatoshis>) satoshis were locked to a claim code.

claimVoucherTransaction.name: Voucher claimed
claimVoucherTransaction.description: A voucher was claimed by revealing its claim code.

voucherInput.name: Voucher claim
voucherInput.description: Spends a voucher by revealing its claim code.

voucherOutput.name: Voucher
voucherOutput.description: Funds locked to the hash of a claim code.

voucherLockingScript.name: Voucher
voucherLockingScript.description: Funds that anyone who knows the claim code can collect.

voucherSatoshis.name: Voucher amount
voucherSatoshis.description: The satoshis locked in the voucher.

codeHash.name: Claim code hash
codeHash.description: The SHA-256 hash of the claim code, 32 bytes.

claimCode.name: Claim code
claimCode.description: The secret code whose SHA-256 hash locks the voucher. It becomes public when the claim is broadcast.
